name: OpenMetadata Service Unit Tests
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    paths:
      - 'openmetadata-service/**'
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'openmetadata-service/**'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency: 
  group: openmetadata-service-unit-tests-${{ github.head_ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  unit-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: ${{ !github.event.pull_request.draft }}
    steps:
    - name: Free Disk Space (Ubuntu)
      uses: jlumbroso/free-disk-space@main
      with:
          tool-cache: false
          android: true
          dotnet: true
          haskell: true
          large-packages: false
          docker-images: false
          swap-storage: true

    - name: Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0

    - name: Set up JDK 21
      uses: actions/setup-java@v4
      with:
        java-version: '21'
        distribution: 'temurin'

    - name: Set up Node.js 18
      uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: '18'
        cache: 'yarn'

    - name: Cache Maven dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.m2/repository
        key: maven-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
        restore-keys: |
          maven-

    - name: Cache Yarn dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: |
          **/node_modules
          **/.yarn/cache
        key: yarn-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/yarn.lock') }}
        restore-keys: |
          yarn-${{ runner.os }}-

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        yarn install --frozen-lockfile
        cd openmetadata-ui/src/main/resources/ui && yarn install --frozen-lockfile

    - name: Build OpenMetadata Service
      run: |
        mvn clean compile -DskipTests -q

    - name: Run Unit Tests
      run: |
        mvn test -Dtest="*Test" -q

    - name: Upload test results
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      if: always()
      with:
        name: test-results
        path: |
          **/target/surefire-reports/
          **/target/test-results/
